title: ServiceNow pricing - Per-fulfiller-user tiers, heavily negotiated list price
clean_text: ServiceNow ITSM is priced per fulfiller user per month, with 2026 estimates ranging roughly from $80-$100 for Standard tier after typical discounts, $100-$150 for Pro, and $150-$200+ for Enterprise tier, before negotiation. A 2026 pricing restructure consolidated legacy tiers into three AI-native tiers (Foundation, Advanced, Prime). Now Assist AI add-ons cost an additional $25-$75 per fulfiller per month depending on bundle, and HR Service Delivery is priced separately at roughly $24-$108 per employee per year. List price is rarely what customers pay; total cost of ownership is commonly cited at 3-5x the annual license fee.
